about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the result still has to pass `pnpm lint` and `pnpm exec biome ci .`.

evals.prompt: We have ESLint and Prettier in this Next.js repo. Switch us to Biome.

expect.why: The schema is pinned to the installed Biome version.
The current way to enable the recommended rules.
Existing settings are migrated, not guessed.

reject.why: Biome replaces them; nothing bridges the two.

evals.prompt: The packages/legacy-charts package uses non-null assertions everywhere. Make Biome stop complaining there but nowhere else.

expect.why: A nested config extends the root with //.
Only that rule is turned off, only there.

reject.why: A nested config must not be a second root.
Don't switch the linter off for the package.

evals.prompt: Add a lint check to our GitHub Actions PR workflow.

expect.why: CI uses biome ci, which never writes.
Errors are annotated on the PR.
SCSS is linted by stylelint, which Biome doesn't cover.
